relationships.subject: icatibant
relationships.evidence_quote: Icatibant, a bradykinin B2 receptor antagonist, has been approved for the treatment of acute attacks of hereditary angioedema

relationships.subject: tissue kallikrein
relationships.evidence_quote: The bradykinin-forming enzyme is shown to be tissue kallikrein, and contribute to generate Lys-bradykinin which acts on bradykinin B2 receptor.

relationships.subject: ACE
relationships.evidence_quote: ACE is an enzyme involved in the kallikrein/kinin system that degrades and inactivates bradykinin.

relationships.subject: bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: Alternatively, bradykinin may serve as a mediator, inducing dermal pain triggered by sweating stimuli.

key_findings: Protocol for crossover trial of icatibant (30 mg) in sweating-induced dermal pain to test the bradykinin-B2 receptor pathway; no results reported
